title: Gate Decisions
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events in ~/.claude/metrics/events/*.ndjson, emitted by two real gates: payload/hooks/workorder-gate.sh (attrs.gate = "workorder"; attrs.action currently either "silent" or "inject", plus an optional numeric attrs.score) and payload/hooks/read-guard.sh (attrs.gate = "read-guard"; attrs.action currently "inject", "silent", or "deny") — Phase 1. Charts attrs.gate x attrs.action.

panels.title: Decision counts by gate x action
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events' attrs.gate and attrs.action, cross-tabulated.

targets.query: SELECT attrs.gate, attrs.action, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'gate.decision' GROUP BY attrs.gate, attrs.action

panels.title: Action distribution, all gates
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 gate.decision events' attrs.action, summed across both gates.

targets.query: SELECT attrs.action, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'gate.decision' GROUP BY attrs.action
